notes.zh: 新增每邮箱独立的系统代理、HTTP CONNECT 和 SOCKS5 设置，支持 v2rayN；远程解析 IMAP 域名，保留 TLS 验证，代理失败不回退直连。首次配置、设置及帮助指南中英双语同步更新。旧配置默认直连，请选择代理、保存后测试连接。
notes.en: Adds per-account System, HTTP CONNECT and SOCKS5 proxies for tools such as v2rayN, with remote IMAP DNS and verified TLS. Proxy failures do not fall back to Direct. Bilingual first-run settings and guides are included. Existing accounts remain Direct; select a proxy, save and test.
